Game Overview

Castle Knight Run is a arcade game built around guide a small knight through an imposing castle in this endless runner. Tap to jump and hold to float, collecting stars while dodging spinning blades and stone obstacles. Experience the thrill as you maintain your pace, aiming for the longest run amidst ever-evolving castle defenses.
